scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n packages,server,web -c blue,cyan,magenta "tsc -b packages/shared/tsconfig.build.json packages/audio-tags/tsconfig.build.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "tsx watch apps/server/src/index.ts" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:packages && tsx watch apps/server/src/index.ts
scripts.build:web: npm run build:packages && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && vite build --config apps/web/vite.config.ts
scripts.build: node scripts/ensure-workspace-links.mjs && tsc -b tsconfig.build.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && vite build --config apps/web/vite.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/audio-tags/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test:shared && npm run test:audio-tags && npm run test:server && npm run test:web
